data.title: bn-2aww: bounded S3 HEAD metadata
data.description: Independent exact-commit review of the versioned S3 HEAD surface. Verify separate HEAD bounds; optional u64 Content-Length and exact ETag/unnormalized Last-Modified; anonymous, presigned, and opaque SigV4 auth/route separation; fixed HEAD method; no body, retry, redirect, or GET fallback; strict header/framing/status/error limits; generated Lua ABI; pinned method-specific MinIO acceptance; deterministic/reproducible packaging; and unchanged frozen 0.1.1 plus GET semantics.
